mostWorthwhile.text: Following filtered fluid through recovery was most worthwhile: it showed why the kidneys need to take useful substances and water back, not just filter blood.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was clear but fairly predictable because the slots and pictures showed where they belonged.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the filter lets glucose and other useful small substances through along with wastes.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each connection a purpose.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how another body system connects, although the straightforward fitting steps were less interesting than following the fluid.
